# Sample lines for the log filter, read by both of its tests:
# test/log_privacy_test.dart and
# android/app/src/test/java/com/vpn/fortivavpn/handler/LogPrivacyTest.kt.
#
# Each line starts with "drop " or "keep ", then the line as `logcat -v time`
# prints it. "drop" lines must never leave the phone. The line types are the
# ones found in the technical logs of connected and dropped events on
# 2026-10-11, and in the core's and the app's code. The sites and addresses
# are example names and documentation addresses. 10.10.34.35 and
# 2001:4188:2:600:10:10:34:36 are the sinkhole addresses Iran's filter answers
# with.
#
# The core's line for each connection's site name.
